issues.desc: CHK-002 should make the user-visible convergence criterion mechanically measurable: starting from one current review round, the normal unattended closeout path must write validation/test evidence, delivery check, summary, live-smoke transcript, DONE-required evidence and done_prepare output with zero metadata-only DEV/REVIEW backsteps, zero extra reviewer re-attestations, zero human acknowledgements, and zero re-execution of an unchanged validation command set.

CHK-001 should explicitly require a fail-closed negative matrix, not only the positive trusted-lineage case: source/story-owned/config/policy/command-set changes, unknown or non-canonical writers, direct/manual artifact mutation, and malformed/unsigned lineage must invalidate or refuse receipt retention. This makes it observable that eliminating metadata-only loops did not weaken real drift protection.
